address.value: 45 The Green, South Bar Street, Banbury, Oxford, OX16 9AB

hours.value: Monday to Tuesday, 8:30–18:15, Wednesday, 8:30–19:00, Thursday, 8:30–17:30, Friday, 8:30–17:00. Saturdays are by appointment.

parking.value: Free parking at the rear via Crouch Street, and disabled parking at the front.

services.detail: The procedures list names routine dental health checks, gum care and maintenance, scale and polish appointments, digital X-rays and 3D scans, fillings and restorations, root canal treatment, and emergency appointments.

The procedures list names dental implants to replace missing teeth, bone grafting and sinus lift procedures, crowns, bridges and dentures, full mouth rehabilitation and bite correction, and wisdom tooth removal and oral surgery.
The procedures list names professional teeth whitening, composite bonding, veneers and smile makeovers, Invisalign and short-term orthodontics, and tooth reshaping and contouring.
The procedures list names gentle care for children, teen and student check-ups, preventive sealants and fluoride treatments, and practical advice on brushing and diet.
The site says to call as soon as possible. It says the practice does its best to see registered or new patients on the same day, and lists an out of hours service for patients of the practice.
The site says implant treatments are led by Dr Fady Michel Tadros. It lists a BDS, MFDS RCSEd, a master’s in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery and a master’s in Oral Implantology.
Denplan Care and Denplan Essentials are listed. The site says these plans help budget monthly, and that the practice is an accredited Denplan Excel practice.

reviews.name: bec hinchliffe
reviews.quote: Dan my son saw a lady Dentist Naz, he had knocked and broken his front tooth. Naz saw Dan on the same day, she was attentive, gentle and did a lovely job repairing his tooth with a composite filling. Thank you Naz and the lovely team at 45 The Green.

reviews.name: katie sunderland
reviews.quote: Once again i was seen within 24 hours - Naz was incredible. Same friendly team and most importantly, exceptional work on not the best teeth!

reviews.name: Garry Williams
reviews.quote: I attended the surgery this morning for part two of a crown fitting. As usual I was greeted by name and with a smile by the receptionist which in its self sets them apart. Then called into the treatment room by my dentist Tim Sunderland. This “legend” has been my dentist for many years and I would NOT go anywhere else. After our usual chat putting the world to rights he did what he had to do to finish the crown and as normal I did not feel a thing. I would like to say a huge thank you to Tim, and his nurse Pauline plus the whole team. Thank you and kind regards Garry Williams.

reviews.name: Alexander
reviews.quote: 5 star for good reason lovely team and professional. Came to my support when let down by other practices absolute incompetence. Thank you The Green Team restored my faith in dentistry. Alexander.

services.name: Booking deposit
services.note: Taken at the time of booking and fully credited after the appointment.

services.name: Sedation
services.note: Intravenous sedation per session, including clinical facilities, nursing support, monitoring and recovery, plus treatment costs. Additional charges may apply for longer appointments.

services.name: Out of hours emergency call out
services.note: Telephone advice and triage are free. The call out fee applies when the practice is opened outside normal working hours. Treatment is charged separately.
